sources.title: ProjectLEAN/semantic-inference-accelerator · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 🌟 Overview VirtualMemoryOS (VMOS) is a lightweight semantic inference accelerator designed for the Hugging Face Gemma Challenge. By instantiating a custom "Gravity (主観)" system within the latent space (J-space), it purges massive KV Cache data and compresses it into a high-fidelity "Semantic Seed" under 1KB. sources.title: inclusionAI · GitHub
sources.snippet: inclusionAI contains the series of open-source projects from Ant Group with dedicated efforts to work towards Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). In here you can find Large Language Models (LLM), Reinforcement Learning (RL) or other systems related to model training and inference, and other AGI-related frameworks or applications.
